title: Heal the Inner Child
coreMove: Inner repair begins when you name the old threat behind a reaction, treat the younger self with care, and choose the next adult act before it reaches someone else.

exampleSpecs.audience: coaches and parents who praise pressure too easily
exampleSpecs.stakes: scarce attention may either feed pressure or teach repair
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show Amelia allocating parent-night attention among Tiger Woods, Earl Woods, California, and golf prodigy pressure before any action occurs

exampleSpecs.audience: parents who confuse rescue and pressure
exampleSpecs.stakes: a child could learn that love depends on public performance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: put Warren in a genuine two-bad-options dilemma around Tiger Woods, Earl Woods, golf prodigy pressure, and California spectators

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who learn through spoken contrast
exampleSpecs.stakes: the display may turn Queen Victoria into either a ruler or a child under control, but not both
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use Gemma and Jeanne in minimal dialogue to let Queen Victoria, the Kensington System, 1837, and Buckingham Palace teach the lesson

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who expect formal power to solve inner fear
exampleSpecs.stakes: the reveal must break the assumption that becoming queen ended the Kensington System's effects
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: set up an expectation about Queen Victoria after 1837, then reveal a Buckingham Palace detail that shows the Kensington System still mattered

exampleSpecs.domain: late-night message thread after a tournament
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who hide pain under achievement talk
exampleSpecs.stakes: a friend may either feed proof-seeking or name the old pressure softly
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: compress the lesson through messages that mention Tiger Woods, Earl Woods, California, and golf prodigy pressure

exampleSpecs.audience: readers whose routine breaks under a small authority cue
exampleSpecs.stakes: a minor correction may turn into old control unless the pause changes the response
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: interrupt Philippine's routine with a Queen Victoria and Kensington System cue, then show the stop and restart
